_comment: Rally Academy proving ground. Generated into mod/levels/<name>/ by tools/mapgen/build.py (ADR 0008). World x right (east), y up (north), metres; the terrain is centred on 0, 0. Pads are rectangles; roads are centre lines (smoothed) painted `width` m wide, their points in a course frame from `origin` facing north (x right, y ahead), the frame venues.json spawns use. Everything within backdrop.flatMarginM of a pad or road stays dead flat at terrain.groundZ; hills rise beyond it, and trees (forest) keep forest.clearanceM from every pad and road. Materials are the stock template level's terrain materials; trees are the game's shared library.
name: ra_proving_ground
title: Rally Academy Proving Ground
description: A flat practice ground for the Rally Academy drills in a wooded valley: strips of gravel, asphalt, snow and dirt, a mud pad and a gravel corner.

roads._comment: The BMP Gravel Track downhill left (venue bmp-gravel-corner, road DR1181), flat: same centre line in the venue's course frame, so drills keep their gates.
West Coast USA's gravel lane DR825 (venues gravel-lane-tightening/opening, D03/D04), flat: its road-network nodes shifted (900, 200) m, same compass orientation, so the drills keep their gates.
The gravel corner's shape in asphalt (same centre line and course frame), for the corner drills' asphalt and snow variants.
The gravel corner's shape in snow (same centre line and course frame), for the corner drills' asphalt and snow variants.
A winding gravel test road, built from straights and arcs heading east: a linked S, a fast right-left pair and a tightening right (D02, A06, F07).

West Coast USA's Off-Road Circuit, its first 640 m from the start line (road nodes dirttrack_1 to 19d: the uphill right, the crest, the descent, the kicker and the blind crest hairpin) with its measured elevation and banking (the berms), shifted (-80, -455) m with the same heading, so D05, D06 and E05 keep their gates (ADR 0010).
Four 90 degree gravel corners of 35 m radius for D07: a banked left (16 %), an off-camber right (10 %), a banked right, an off-camber left, joined by short straights (ADR 0010).
E06: a straight dirt road with a kicker 150 m from its start (rises 1.6 m over 10 m), a landing that falls away past the crown and a level run-out (ADR 0010).
E07: a dirt track, smooth for 80 m, then 200 m of uneven ground through a gentle S (bumps a little different under each wheel), then smooth again (ADR 0010).
E08's creek: a channel 10 m wide with a mud bed 1 m below the ground, meandering across the ford road; water fills it to 0.6 m below the ground (layout water `creek`). No decals: not driven.
E08: a dirt road that dips 1 m into the creek, 80 m of approach, a 12 m level bed under 0.4 m of water, then out (ADR 0010).
D09 uphill hairpins on gravel: a switchback up the mountain face, three hairpins (left, right, left) of 11 m radius, legs at 25 degrees to the contour (ADR 0010).
D09 uphill hairpins on asphalt: a switchback up the mountain face, three hairpins (left, right, left) of 11 m radius, legs at 25 degrees to the contour (ADR 0010).
D09 uphill hairpins on snow: a switchback up the mountain face, three hairpins (left, right, left) of 11 m radius, legs at 25 degrees to the contour (ADR 0010).

slopes._comment: D09's mountain face: climbs 16 % northwards for 200 m, then a 50 m plateau; three switchbacks on it.
